## Problem or contribution

What would you like to improve? If you already have code, link your public fork or branch.

## Proposed approach

Describe the change and alternatives considered. For a platform port, name the OS, architecture, build commands and what works so far.

## Testing and limits

What did you test? What remains untested? Do not include credentials, signing certificates, private recordings or transcripts.
